_comment: Control-plane config written by the orchestrator agent and read by both bots at the top of every scan. Each bot reads ONLY its own section and runs ONLY the strategies/filters listed as active, ALWAYS clamped to that bot's hard-coded validated universe (config can narrow behavior, never invent it). A missing or malformed file fails OPEN to all-active (current behavior). Do not hand-edit while the agent is running. Sibling contract files in this dir: trade_ledger.jsonl (bot writes resolved trades, agent reads), bot_events.jsonl (bot writes escalations, agent reads). Seeded 2026-06-13 to exactly mirror current live behavior: spot=6 strategies+4 filters, futures=7 strategies+3 filters.
